sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: To the Light - A Time to Throw Stones is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I doubt Peacekeeper will ever dare go against Lightkeeper again after everything that's happened. But this isn't over yet. The operatives who kept information from Lightkeeper and secretly worked with Peacekeeper are still alive. And from what I understand, they don't even realize they've been compromised. For some reason, Lightkeeper doesn't want to hold a "public execution" to make an example of them and intimidate the rest of his operatives. Maybe he doesn't see the need, or maybe he's trying to avoid creating another conflict ... Hard to say. But he's going to quietly eliminate the traitors he's already identified. He'll send them on a job where the fighters will supposedly die in the line of duty. The group will arrive at the Lab soon with a new assignment. You need to meet them there and deliver Lightkeeper's sentence to each of them. I'm not sure your skills and the element of surprise will be enough to take down an entire squad of fighters. So you'd better prepare seriously. And don't forget to bring their dogtags. I'll pass them on to Lightkeeper."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 2 PMC operatives within one raid in The Lab

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +55,000 EXP
"Excellent. I'll send the dogtags to Lightkeeper with the next shipment. I doubt this whole affair is doing much good for his plans, but it's a unique opportunity for us. And I'm already seeing the positive effects of the work we've done."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to eliminate 2 PMC operatives within one raid in The Lab.
